title: Anyone been to any of these infinite houses

classification.question_topic: Asking if others have been to the same 'infinite houses' dream locations (brothel, horror challenge castle, scare hotel, house of healers, water park home).

position.relative_to: exists in the same realm as other infinite houses

qualities.raw_description: “ethereal quality”; “able to walk through room after room before actually getting where you are going”; “endless girls that live inside the house”; “hypermodern futuristic yet Victorian architecture”; “one of the most beatiful places you ever ever seen in a dream”; “you would truly want to stay here forever”; “only allowed to come when you’ve been gifted a session by the dream entities”; “guaranteed to receive it unlike other dream locations.”

“most ethereal and hardest to describe”; “feels like you’re on acid”; “heavily populated with other dreamers”; “many rooms”; “unlock them as you go further and further”; “sometimes things will shift and you won’t be where you thought you were”; “once the doors of the room close you are no longer able to return back”; “no longer subject to normal dream rules”; “no longer allowed to awaken except by hard awakening”; “rooms will shift and change often when you aren’t looking”; “guaranteed to get lost or even trapped”; “not known whether anyone has completed the challenge.”

“no main entrance or corridor”; “you seem to just no clip into one of the rooms”; “instantly terrified but you have no idea why”; “always the only human here”; “feel surrounded by entities you can’t see… demonic and terrifying and otherworldly”; “rooms are liminal, looking like scenes from a Stephen King movie”; “floors are crooked and slanted”; “overwhelming sense that something is not right, and you shouldn’t be here”; “might also see clothing especially winter coats”; “never… put on any of the clothing.”

“house populated by psychic dreamers… Psychonauts, lucid dreamers”; “a hub to interface and share knowledge”; “encounter… explorers”; “feel like you’re sitting at a table with the most interesting… people you’ve ever encountered”; “invite only similar to the infinite brothel.”

position.relative_to: contained within the structures of an infinite mansion; sometimes appears outside but is inside the mansion

qualities.raw_description: “appears to be outside but… contained within… an infinite mansion”; “some areas… indoor water park and some… expansive outdoor water park”; “float endlessly through passages between rooms”; “enter more or less active areas”; “inner tubes… can also float through the air”; “encouraged to act as if you are a child once again”; “most overpopulated home… still fairly luxurious”; “shining natural light and expansive waterfalls and fixtures”; “occasionally… cheap childlike quality… for nostalgia.”

connections.qualities: Within the house: walking “through room after room before actually getting where you are going.”

Progression via rooms/doors: rooms “unlock… further and further”; “once the doors… close you are no longer able to return back”; shifting layout causes disorientation (“you won’t be where you thought you were”).
Entry occurs by “no clip into one of the rooms”; “no main entrance or corridor.”
Movement described as floating: “float endlessly through passages between rooms”; inner tubes “can also float through the air.”

boundaries.description: Progress is constrained by room/door rules: doors closing prevents returning; rooms “unlock” over time and the layout shifts, causing being “lost or even trapped.”

interactions.description: Selecting residents (“endless girls”) for sexual experiences including “orgies” and “very perverted things”; “No one ever judges you.” Access is “gifted a session by the dream entities” and when gifted it is “guaranteed.”

entities_involved.description: “endless girls that live inside the house”

interactions.description: Moving through and “unlocking” rooms; environment shifts so “you won’t be where you thought you were”; after doors close you “are no longer able to return back”; “guaranteed to get lost or even trapped.”

entities_involved.description: “other dreamers” who are “equally confused as to how they got there”

interactions.description: Instant fear on arrival (“instantly terrified but you have no idea why”); perceives unseen surrounding entities; notes presence of clothing (winter coats) and a rule: “never… put on any of the clothing.”

entities_involved.description: Unseen entities that feel “demonic and terrifying and otherworldly”

interactions.description: Knowledge-sharing hub: “interface and share knowledge”; sitting “at a table” with various invited dreamers/figures; invite-only access.

entities_involved.description: “psychic dreamers… Psychonauts, lucid dreamers”; “light workers… spiritual masters… explorers”

interactions.description: Floating through water passages between rooms; moving between “more or less active areas”; uses inner tubes that can float “through the air”; encouraged to behave “as if you are a child once again.”

extraction.extraction_notes: Post describes multiple recurring dream locations (“infinite houses”) with strong qualitative detail. Spatial data is mostly internal (rooms/passages/doors, no-entrance/no-clip, shifting layout) rather than a global map linking locations together. Some terms (e.g., “hard awakening”) are recorded as described without interpretation.
